column1: # The farm film's shot plan (src/episodes/farm/beats.ts CUTS) — a worked example of shots.tsv

column6: what
Jake eats cereal at the kitchen table, the red phone buzzes; the dog lies at his feet; blurred bread, juice, bottle in front; slow push
from behind Jake: he holds up the phone, red EMERGENCY ALERT, red glow pulsing on the kitchen
high wide of the farm (house, barn, shed, pond, crop rows, dirt road), push-in
top-down: the farm as a round island of trees; fields fade in; zoom out to a satellite patchwork, the farm in a dashed circle
Jake walks right across the yard with the dog; house and barn behind
3/4 walk past the weathered barn wall, keys swinging in his hand, the dog trots
Jake strides to the blue pickup, takes the handle, steps up into the seat; the dog sits by the wheel
the empty road to a dark hazy city with three smoke columns; fence posts slide past
cab POV: wheel, fuel gauge; the hand turns the key… a 3-D red NO. slams in; the hand pulls the key back
dark regional map: WICHITA tag over a red ring, dots stream in along radial roads; JAKE'S FARM pin
bathroom, white brick tiles: Jake turns the bath tap on, water runs
utility sink filling a big pot; pegboard tools
the tub filling
garage shelves packed with jugs; a hand sets one more on the middle shelf
cross-section: house, power pole, well pipe to the water table, pump; flow climbs; the power cut greys everything
dark: the pressure gauge needle falls to 0, the tap's last drip
dark shed: the door opens on Jake's silhouette in a shaft of light
Jake kneels and yanks the red generator's cord; angry → worried
close-up: worried brows, wavy mouth; exhaust puffs behind
top-down farm map, dim, dense canopy; the GENERATOR pin glows; dashed rings ripple out
foggy forest of trunks at four depths; zombie silhouettes turn toward the sound, eyes glowing
the coop: a big rooster mid-frame, hens pecking, a blurred black hen in front
cows grazing by the fence, chewing, tails swishing
a brown horse by the fence, tail and ear flicks
the dog sits by a fence post; a bird lands; the dog barks; the bird flies off
Jake, eyes shut, done with it; the dog looks up at him
tilted 3-D map of the farm, noise rings over every pen
the map darkens: STAYING QUIET? small, ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE big red
Jake swings the farm gate shut, the dog sits beside it
close-up: a hand clicks a brass padlock, the chain wrapped round the post
top-down: a green SAFE ZONE square around the house; animal icons slide inside
desk from above: a hand grips the pen and writes the DAY 1 – SUPPLIES list
the SUPPLIES – DAY 1 card ticks in row by row, MEDICAL · LOW in red
porch at dawn, warm glow behind the barn: Jake with a mug, smiling; his smile drops
the dog on the porch; its head snaps toward the barn, ears up
dog close-up: a low growl, lips up
Jake, worried → shocked O, mug in hand
over his shoulder at night: the barn doors ajar, a figure in the dark gap
two glowing eyes in the gap, one slow blink, a lean back into the dark
PART 2 · SOMETHING IS IN THE BARN · FOLLOW TO SURVIVE DAY 1
